In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of transparent SWCNT thin films for ammonia vapor sensing applications.
the development of transparent and flexible ammonia vapor sensors based on single walled carbon nano tube thin films at room temperature.
the synthesis of optically transparent single walled random networks for room temperature ammonia vapor sensing application.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SWCNT random networks are promising for room temperature ammonia vapor detection.
the transparent SWCNT thin film is able to detect ammonia gas at room temperature with good selectivity and reversibility.
the transparent SWCNT thin film based ammonia vapor sensor is a promising candidate for environmental monitoring applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully developed a transparent ammonia sensor with high sensitivity at room temperature using SWCNT thin films.
the transparent CNT network is able to detect ammonia at room temperature with the help of electrical resistance change and the detection limit is very low.
transparent SWCNT random networks are capable to detect low concentration ammonia vapor selectively at room temperature with fast sensing and response times.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SWCNT random network is a potential candidate for ammonia vapor sensor at room temperature.
transparent SWCNT thin film is a potential candidate for low cost and selective ammonia sensor at room temperature.
the transparent SWCNT random network can be used as an alternative to the ITO based transparent electrodes and as a potential candidate as a room temperature gas sensor for ammonia detection.
